title: Webhook Delivery Engine, HMAC Signatures & Exponential Retries
description: The webhooks module delivers outbound webhook notification pipelines. It features HMAC-SHA256 signature verification headers, exponential backoff retries, dead-letter queue (DLQ) routing, and payload delivery logging for Rust microservices.
